classes.A typographic: the quote's words equal one passage's words; only quotation marks, other punctuation, spacing or a footnote marker differ
classes.B elided: the quote is one passage with one run of whole words left out; nothing added or changed
classes.C added: the quote is one passage with words added; nothing left out or changed
classes.D substituted: one word or short phrase of the passage replaced by other words
classes.E joined or paraphrased: words from separate places joined, or the statement reworded beyond one replacement
classes.F not in the body: the quote is the item title (the body is another page) or empty
